literature.headline_zh: 季节性流感病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期季节性流感病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 通过系统血清学检测,疫苗接种诱导了强烈的同源和异源抗体反应,其中雌性小鼠对全病毒H1N1和H5N1产生的IgG滴度高于雄性,这主要由对唾液酸酶(NA)而非血凝素(HA)蛋白的IgG反应更强所介导。在接种H1N1的雌性小鼠中,交叉反应性H5N1 IgG滴度更高,且主要由针对N1的IgG滴度更高所介导。在接种H1N1 疫苗接种后,雌性小鼠对异源病毒的唾液酸酶抑制滴度高于雄性;在接种H5N1 疫苗接种后,雌性小鼠对疫苗和异源病毒的唾液酸酶抑制滴度均高于雄性。 [10.1016/j.vaccine.2026.129189]
本研究发现,血凝素可以通过结构可塑性增强酸稳定性,涉及静电相互作用、氢键网络和疏水堆积等机制。 [10.1038/s44298-026-00236-y]
所有BTM样本均未检出牛布鲁氏菌病,未检测到甲型流感病毒M基因RNA,且在探索性AIV抗体ELISA中没有样本超过阳性阈值。Q热抗体在602个BTM样本中有343个被检测到(57.0%)。 [10.1016/j.rvsc.2026.106418]

系统发育分析显示,在2025–26年的冬季,亚系K病毒株在以色列占据主导地位。通过在循环亚系K病毒株中发现的八个新识别的血凝素突变,定义了显著的疫苗不匹配。血清学检测显示,疫苗接种单独使用可使抗体滴度增加两到三倍,而对亚系K病毒株的基础保护仍非常低。接种疫苗康复者通过自然感染引发了显著更强、更广泛的免疫应答,分别对疫苗样和亚系K病毒株的中和抗体增加了6倍和13倍。 [10.3390/vaccines14100838]
结果表明,与 甲型H3N2流感病毒 住院治疗相比,1945 年之前出生的人和 1994 年至 2009 年之间出生的人对 甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09 住院治疗提供了部分保护。随着时间的推移,这种部分保护的影响逐渐减弱,导致 2024-2025 年流感季节住院率更高。 [10.1093/infdis/jiag232]

[10.1016/j.vaccine.2026.129189]

The study found that hemagglutinin can increase acid stability through structural plasticity, involving mechanisms like electrostatic interactions, hydrogen-bonding networks and hydrophobic packing. [10.1038/s44298-026-00236-y]

[10.63501/w1mrve44]

All BTM samples were negative for bovine brucellosis, no influenza A virus M-gene RNA was detected, and no samples exceeded the positivity threshold in the exploratory AIV antibody ELISA. Q fever antibodies were detected in 343 of 602 BTM samples (57.0%). [10.1016/j.rvsc.2026.106418]

papers.title: Multicomponent vaccination against seasonal influenza and COVID-19: a strategy to address the continued global burden of disease in adults.
papers.abstract: Seasonal influenza and SARS-CoV-2 are respiratory viruses that represent a global health concern, causing substantial numbers of hospitalizations and mortality, particularly among high-risk groups, including infants and older adults. Together these associated respiratory diseases and related complications are among the leading causes of morbidity and mortality. Although effective vaccines are available for protection against influenza and COVID-19, vaccine uptake remains below the levels recommended by the World Health Organization (WHO). Increasing vaccination coverage is critical for protecting vulnerable populations and reducing strain on healthcare systems. To improve vaccine uptake, the WHO recommends co-administering influenza and COVID-19 vaccines when epidemiologically justified. A multicomponent vaccine approach in adults could go beyond the current co-administration approach, as it has the potential to streamline delivery, reduce missed vaccination opportunities, and enhance vaccine coverage among individuals at risk. This manuscript reviews the current evidence on multicomponent vaccination for protection against seasonal influenza and COVID-19. We summarize published literature on the potential public health impacts of a multicomponent vaccination approach, discuss associated challenges, and review multicomponent vaccines currently in development. The studies in this review highlight various potential benefits of a multicomponent approach, including simplified dosing, greater vaccination coverage, and reduced disease burden and costs. Healthcare workers expressed a preference for a combination vaccine over standalone influenza or COVID-19 vaccines, indicating a high likelihood of recommending it to patients. Consumers also showed strong interest. For multicomponent vaccination to succeed, key considerations include the optimal timing of administration and appropriate strain selection for both the influenza and SARS-CoV-2 viruses. Promising multicomponent influenza-COVID-19 vaccine candidates currently being evaluated in clinical trials may represent an important advancement in adult immunization strategy, and a meaningful opportunity to strengthen protection against two of the most consequential respiratory pathogens worldwide.

papers.title_zh: Multicomponent vaccination against seasonal influenza and COVID-19: a strategy to address the continued global burden of disease in adults.
papers.source_body_en: Seasonal influenza and SARS-CoV-2 are respiratory viruses that represent a global health concern, causing substantial numbers of hospitalizations and mortality, particularly among high-risk groups, including infants and older adults. Together these associated respiratory diseases and related complications are among the leading causes of morbidity and mortality. Although effective vaccines are available for protection against influenza and COVID-19, vaccine uptake remains below the levels recommended by the World Health Organization (WHO). Increasing vaccination coverage is critical for protecting vulnerable populations and reducing strain on healthcare systems. To improve vaccine uptake, the WHO recommends co-administering influenza and COVID-19 vaccines when epidemiologically justified. A multicomponent vaccine approach in adults could go beyond the current co-administration approach, as it has the potential to streamline delivery, reduce missed vaccination opportunities, and enhance vaccine coverage among individuals at risk. This manuscript reviews the current evidence on multicomponent vaccination for protection against seasonal influenza and COVID-19. We summarize published literature on the potential public health impacts of a multicomponent vaccination approach, discuss associated challenges, and review multicomponent vaccines currently in development. The studies in this review highlight various potential benefits of a multicomponent approach, including simplified dosing, greater vaccination coverage, and reduced disease burden and costs. Healthcare workers expressed a preference for a combination vaccine over standalone influenza or COVID-19 vaccines, indicating a high likelihood of recommending it to patients. Consumers also showed strong interest. For multicomponent vaccination to succeed, key considerations include the optimal timing of administration and appropriate strain selection for both the influenza and SARS-CoV-2 viruses. Promising multicomponent influenza-COVID-19 vaccine candidates currently being evaluated in clinical trials may represent an important advancement in adult immunization strategy, and a meaningful opportunity to strengthen protection against two of the most consequential respiratory pathogens worldwide.

papers.title: From Bench Curiosity to Licensed Product: The History, Science, and Clinical Translation of Messenger RNA Vaccines, with Particular Reference to Seasonal Influenza
papers.abstract: Seasonal influenza remains one of the most persistent causes of preventable respiratory morbidity and mortality worldwide, and the egg-propagated inactivated vaccines that have anchored control efforts for eight decades deliver only moderate and highly variable protection. Messenger RNA (mRNA) technology, validated at global scale during the COVID-19 pandemic, has been advanced as a structural remedy for the manufacturing latency and egg-adaptation artifacts that constrain conventional influenza vaccines. In August 2026, the first mRNA influenza vaccine was licensed in the United States, making a historical synthesis of the field both possible and timely. To trace the intellectual and technical lineage of mRNA vaccines from the discovery of messenger RNA in 1961 to the licensure of mRNA-1010 in 2026, and to appraise the evidence supporting mRNA platforms for seasonal and pandemic influenza. A structured narrative review was conducted. PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, ClinicalTrials.gov, and regulatory and sponsor communications were searched from January 1961 through August 2026 using controlled vocabulary and free-text terms for messenger RNA, nucleoside modification, lipid nanoparticle, and influenza vaccine. Sources were selected for historical priority, methodological weight, or regulatory consequence rather than by exhaustive enumeration, and were synthesized chronologically and thematically. Six decades of work resolve into four inflection points. The first was the demonstration between 1978 and 1990 that exogenous mRNA could be delivered into cells and into living animals and translated into functional protein. The second was the recognition in 2005 that substituting modified nucleosides for uridine suppresses innate immune sensing of synthetic mRNA, converting an intolerably inflammatory molecule into a usable therapeutic. The third was the maturation of ionizable lipid nanoparticle delivery between 2010 and 2015. The fourth was the COVID-19 pandemic, which supplied the capital, regulatory precedent, and manufacturing scale that no influenza program could have generated on its own. Influenza-specific mRNA constructs protected animals from lethal challenge in 2012 and entered human trials against H10N8 and H7N9 in 2015. The pivotal Fluent trial, which randomly assigned 40,703 adults aged 50 years or older, reported a relative vaccine efficacy of 26.6 percent for mRNA-1010 against reverse transcriptase polymerase chain reaction-confirmed influenza-like illness compared with a licensed standard-dose comparator, at the cost of substantially higher reactogenicity. The United States Food and Drug Administration licensed the vaccine on August 5, 2026, with full approval for adults aged 50 through 64 years and accelerated approval for adults aged 65 years and older. The mRNA platform has moved from bench curiosity to a licensed influenza product in a single professional generation, and it addresses the specific failure modes of egg-based manufacture rather than merely substituting one antigen delivery system for another. Its near-term value lies less in dramatic efficacy gains than in compressed strain-to-vial timelines, elimination of egg-adaptation artifacts, and pandemic responsiveness. Realizing that value now depends less on immunology than on policy, financing, and public confidence, all of which are presently unsettled in the United States.

analysis.scope_and_question: Seasonal influenza (A1) – does mRNA vaccination (A2) provide superior protection compared with egg‐based inactivated vaccines (A1) for adults?
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: Structured narrative review (A5) using PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, ClinicalTrials.gov and regulatory/sponsor communications (A6) searched Jan 1961‐Aug 2026; sources selected for historical priority, methodological weight or regulatory consequence (A7).
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The first mRNA influenza vaccine (A3) was licensed in August 2026, showing 26.6 % efficacy against RT‐PCR‐confirmed ILI in the pivotal Fluent trial (A14) with higher reactogenicity, and the platform resolves egg‐adaptation issues while enabling rapid pandemic response (A16, A17).
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: Limited efficacy data in younger adults, modest protection (26.6 %) with notable reactogenicity (A14), and dependence on policy, financing and public confidence (A18) represent current evidence gaps and controversies.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Realizing the near‐term value of mRNA influenza vaccines (A17) depends on policy, financing and public confidence (A18), prompting priorities for accelerated regulatory pathways, enhanced public trust, and expanded efficacy data in broader age groups.

analysis.summary_en: Seasonal influenza remains a major cause of preventable respiratory disease, and egg‐based inactivated vaccines offer only moderate, variable protection. mRNA technology, proven at scale during COVID‐19, addresses manufacturing latency and egg‐adaptation artifacts. In August 2026 the first mRNA influenza vaccine (mRNA‐1010) received US licensure for adults 50‐64 (full) and 65+ (accelerated). The pivotal Fluent trial (40,703 adults ≥50) reported 26.6 % relative efficacy against RT‐PCR‐confirmed ILI with higher reactogenicity. The platform overcomes egg‐adaptation issues, shortens strain‐to‐vial timelines and enhances pandemic responsiveness, though efficacy gains are modest and depend on policy, financing and public confidence. Current challenges include limited efficacy data in younger adults, safety profile, and the need for robust real‐world evidence. Research priorities involve expanding efficacy studies across age groups, improving reactogenicity management, and integrating mRNA platforms into seasonal and pandemic influenza vaccination strategies.

analysis_en.research_and_practice_implications: Realizing the near‐term value of mRNA influenza vaccines (A17) depends on policy, financing and public confidence (A18), prompting priorities for accelerated regulatory pathways, enhanced public trust, and expanded efficacy data in broader age groups.

papers.title_zh: 从实验台上的好奇到获批产品:messenger RNA 疫苗的历程、科学与临床转化,特别关注疫苗
papers.source_body_en: Seasonal influenza remains one of the most persistent causes of preventable respiratory morbidity and mortality worldwide, and the egg-propagated inactivated vaccines that have anchored control efforts for eight decades deliver only moderate and highly variable protection. Messenger RNA (mRNA) technology, validated at global scale during the COVID-19 pandemic, has been advanced as a structural remedy for the manufacturing latency and egg-adaptation artifacts that constrain conventional influenza vaccines. In August 2026, the first mRNA influenza vaccine was licensed in the United States, making a historical synthesis of the field both possible and timely. To trace the intellectual and technical lineage of mRNA vaccines from the discovery of messenger RNA in 1961 to the licensure of mRNA-1010 in 2026, and to appraise the evidence supporting mRNA platforms for seasonal and pandemic influenza. A structured narrative review was conducted. PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, ClinicalTrials.gov, and regulatory and sponsor communications were searched from January 1961 through August 2026 using controlled vocabulary and free-text terms for messenger RNA, nucleoside modification, lipid nanoparticle, and influenza vaccine. Sources were selected for historical priority, methodological weight, or regulatory consequence rather than by exhaustive enumeration, and were synthesized chronologically and thematically. Six decades of work resolve into four inflection points. The first was the demonstration between 1978 and 1990 that exogenous mRNA could be delivered into cells and into living animals and translated into functional protein. The second was the recognition in 2005 that substituting modified nucleosides for uridine suppresses innate immune sensing of synthetic mRNA, converting an intolerably inflammatory molecule into a usable therapeutic. The third was the maturation of ionizable lipid nanoparticle delivery between 2010 and 2015. The fourth was the COVID-19 pandemic, which supplied the capital, regulatory precedent, and manufacturing scale that no influenza program could have generated on its own. Influenza-specific mRNA constructs protected animals from lethal challenge in 2012 and entered human trials against H10N8 and H7N9 in 2015. The pivotal Fluent trial, which randomly assigned 40,703 adults aged 50 years or older, reported a relative vaccine efficacy of 26.6 percent for mRNA-1010 against reverse transcriptase polymerase chain reaction-confirmed influenza-like illness compared with a licensed standard-dose comparator, at the cost of substantially higher reactogenicity. The United States Food and Drug Administration licensed the vaccine on August 5, 2026, with full approval for adults aged 50 through 64 years and accelerated approval for adults aged 65 years and older. The mRNA platform has moved from bench curiosity to a licensed influenza product in a single professional generation, and it addresses the specific failure modes of egg-based manufacture rather than merely substituting one antigen delivery system for another. Its near-term value lies less in dramatic efficacy gains than in compressed strain-to-vial timelines, elimination of egg-adaptation artifacts, and pandemic responsiveness. Realizing that value now depends less on immunology than on policy, financing, and public confidence, all of which are presently unsettled in the United States.

papers.title: Four-season bulk tank milk surveillance for brucellosis, influenza A virus, and Q fever in Korean dairy farms.
papers.abstract: Bulk tank milk (BTM) provides a practical, non-invasive matrix for repeated herd-level surveillance in dairy farms. This study evaluated a four-season BTM framework for bovine brucellosis, influenza A virus, and Q fever in Korean dairy farms. In 2025, 602 BTM samples were collected from 167 farms in spring and summer and 134 farms in autumn and winter. Seasonal comparisons were interpreted cautiously because farm composition changed after summer. Bovine brucellosis was tested by milk ring test, influenza A virus by M-gene real-time RT-PCR, and Q fever antibodies by ELISA. An exploratory avian influenza virus (AIV) antibody ELISA was also applied to whey. Coxiella burnetii PCR testing was restricted to nine participating farms in Daegu Metropolitan City, and one BTM real-time PCR-positive farm was further investigated using sera from 105 lactating cows. All BTM samples were negative for bovine brucellosis, no influenza A virus M-gene RNA was detected, and no samples exceeded the positivity threshold in the exploratory AIV antibody ELISA. Q fever antibodies were detected in 343 of 602 BTM samples (57.0%). burnetii DNA was detected by real-time PCR only in spring and summer BTM samples from one of the nine Daegu farms. In this farm, all serum samples were PCR-negative, whereas 46 of 105 cows were antibody-positive (43.8%). These findings support repeated BTM testing as a complementary herd-level screening approach, particularly for Q fever monitoring.

papers.title_zh: 韩国奶牛场中布鲁氏菌病、甲型流感病毒和Q热的四季批量奶池检测监测
papers.source_body_en: Bulk tank milk (BTM) provides a practical, non-invasive matrix for repeated herd-level surveillance in dairy farms. This study evaluated a four-season BTM framework for bovine brucellosis, influenza A virus, and Q fever in Korean dairy farms. In 2025, 602 BTM samples were collected from 167 farms in spring and summer and 134 farms in autumn and winter. Seasonal comparisons were interpreted cautiously because farm composition changed after summer. Bovine brucellosis was tested by milk ring test, influenza A virus by M-gene real-time RT-PCR, and Q fever antibodies by ELISA. An exploratory avian influenza virus (AIV) antibody ELISA was also applied to whey. Coxiella burnetii PCR testing was restricted to nine participating farms in Daegu Metropolitan City, and one BTM real-time PCR-positive farm was further investigated using sera from 105 lactating cows. All BTM samples were negative for bovine brucellosis, no influenza A virus M-gene RNA was detected, and no samples exceeded the positivity threshold in the exploratory AIV antibody ELISA. Q fever antibodies were detected in 343 of 602 BTM samples (57.0%). burnetii DNA was detected by real-time PCR only in spring and summer BTM samples from one of the nine Daegu farms. In this farm, all serum samples were PCR-negative, whereas 46 of 105 cows were antibody-positive (43.8%). These findings support repeated BTM testing as a complementary herd-level screening approach, particularly for Q fever monitoring.

papers.title: Influenza A(H3N2) Subclade K During the 2025–26 Season and Differential Humoral Responses in Vaccinated Individuals Versus Vaccinated Convalescents in Israel
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: During the 2025–26 influenza season, the antigenically distinct A(H3N2) subclade K emerged and spread globally, raising significant concerns regarding seasonal vaccine effectiveness. This study aimed to map antigenic and structural divergence of this novel strain compared to the 2025/26 A(H3N2) vaccine component. Furthermore, we investigated how this vaccine mismatch impacts functional humoral immunity by directly comparing antibody neutralization profiles between individuals with vaccine-induced protection and those with infection-acquired immunity. Methods: Phylogenetic and structural modeling analyses were performed on 2025–26 Israeli influenza samples to identify genetic distances and mutations in the hemagglutinin protein compared to the 2025/26 A(H3N2) vaccine component. Hemagglutination inhibition (HI) and microneutralization assays were conducted using 2025–26 winter serum samples from a cohort of vaccinated healthcare workers and vaccinated convalescents to quantify antibody responses against both vaccine-like and subclade K strains. Results: Phylogenetic analysis revealed a clear dominance of the subclade K strain in Israel during the winter of 2025–26. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于2025–26流感季节出现了抗原上显著不同的甲型H3N2流感病毒亚系K,本研究的必要性由此产生,这引发了对季节性疫苗有效性的担忧。本研究旨在了解这种新型病毒株与2025/26 甲型H3N2流感病毒 疫苗组分之间的抗原和结构差异。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究在2025–26年的以色列冬季进行,使用了接种疫苗的医护人员和接种疫苗康复者的血清样本。研究人群包括具有疫苗诱导保护和感染获得性免疫的个体,从而能够直接比较针对疫苗样和亚系K病毒株的抗体反应。
elements_zh.methods: 对2025–26年以色列流感样本进行了系统发育和结构建模分析,以确定其与2025/26 甲型H3N2流感病毒 疫苗组分之间的遗传距离和血凝素突变。使用血凝抑制(HI)和微中和试验来量化针对疫苗样和亚系K病毒株的抗体反应。
elements_zh.main_results: 系统发育分析显示,在2025–26年的冬季,亚系K病毒株在以色列占据主导地位。通过在循环亚系K病毒株中发现的八个新识别的血凝素突变,定义了显著的疫苗不匹配。血清学检测显示,疫苗接种单独使用可使抗体滴度增加两到三倍,而对亚系K病毒株的基础保护仍非常低。接种疫苗康复者通过自然感染引发了显著更强、更广泛的免疫应答,分别对疫苗样和亚系K病毒株的中和抗体增加了6倍和13倍。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为,与疫苗接种单独使用相比,自然感染能更显著地增强结合和中和抗体,这可能有助于对抗原漂移变异株提供更广泛的交叉保护。这一发现突显了当前流感病毒株预测的局限性,并强调了需要更灵活的疫苗平台的必要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调了在疫苗开发中考虑自然感染诱导的免疫力的重要性,并突出了改进病毒株预测以更好地匹配流行的流感病毒株的必要性,特别是在抗原漂移的背景下。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其专注于特定人群(接种疫苗的医护人员和康复者)和地理区域(以色列),这可能影响其普遍适用性。由于依赖血清学和系统发育分析,且缺乏长期随访或更广泛的人群数据,证据强度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 背景/目的:在2025–26流感季节,抗原上显著不同的甲型H3N2流感病毒亚系K在全球范围内出现并传播,引发了对季节性疫苗有效性的重大关注。本研究旨在绘制这种新型病毒株与2025/26 甲型H3N2流感病毒 疫苗组分之间的抗原和结构差异。此外,我们还研究了这种疫苗不匹配如何影响功能性体液免疫,通过直接比较具有疫苗诱导保护和感染获得性免疫的个体之间的抗体中和谱来实现。方法:对2025–26年以色列流感样本进行了系统发育和结构建模分析,以确定其与2025/26 甲型H3N2流感病毒 疫苗组分之间的遗传距离和血凝素突变。使用2025–26冬季血清样本,对接种疫苗的医护人员和接种疫苗康复者进行了血凝抑制(HI)和微中和试验,以量化针对疫苗样和亚系K病毒株的抗体反应。结果:系统发育分析显示,在2025–26年的冬季,亚系K病毒株在以色列占据主导地位。通过在循环亚系K病毒株中发现的八个新识别的血凝素突变,定义了显著的疫苗不匹配。血清学检测表明,尽管疫苗接种单独使用可使抗体滴度增加两到三倍,但对亚系K病毒株的基础保护仍非常低。相反,接种疫苗康复者通过自然感染引发了显著更强、更广泛的免疫应答,分别对疫苗样和亚系K病毒株的中和抗体增加了6倍和13倍。结论:与疫苗接种单独使用相比,自然感染能更显著地增强结合和中和抗体,这可能有助于对抗原漂移变异株提供更广泛的交叉保护。这些发现突显了当前流感病毒株预测的主要局限性,并强调了需要更快、更灵活的疫苗制造平台的紧迫性,以更好地匹配实际流行的病毒株。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于2025–26流感季节出现了抗原上显著不同的甲型H3N2流感病毒亚系K,本研究的必要性由此产生,这引发了对季节性疫苗有效性的担忧。本研究旨在了解这种新型病毒株与2025/26 甲型H3N2流感病毒 疫苗组分之间的抗原和结构差异。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究在2025–26年的以色列冬季进行,使用了接种疫苗的医护人员和接种疫苗康复者的血清样本。研究人群包括具有疫苗诱导保护和感染获得性免疫的个体,从而能够直接比较针对疫苗样和亚系K病毒株的抗体反应。

analysis_zh.main_results: 系统发育分析显示,在2025–26年的冬季,亚系K病毒株在以色列占据主导地位。通过在循环亚系K病毒株中发现的八个新识别的血凝素突变,定义了显著的疫苗不匹配。血清学检测显示,疫苗接种单独使用可使抗体滴度增加两到三倍,而对亚系K病毒株的基础保护仍非常低。接种疫苗康复者通过自然感染引发了显著更强、更广泛的免疫应答,分别对疫苗样和亚系K病毒株的中和抗体增加了6倍和13倍。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为,与疫苗接种单独使用相比,自然感染能更显著地增强结合和中和抗体,这可能有助于对抗原漂移变异株提供更广泛的交叉保护。这一发现突显了当前流感病毒株预测的局限性,并强调了需要更灵活的疫苗平台的必要性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调了在疫苗开发中考虑自然感染诱导的免疫力的重要性,并突出了改进病毒株预测以更好地匹配流行的流感病毒株的必要性,特别是在抗原漂移的背景下。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其专注于特定人群(接种疫苗的医护人员和康复者)和地理区域(以色列),这可能影响其普遍适用性。由于依赖血清学和系统发育分析,且缺乏长期随访或更广泛的人群数据,证据强度中等。

papers.title: In silico analysis of pH stabilising mutations of hemagglutinin of influenza A virus H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b
papers.abstract: Abstract Highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) viruses are expanding their host range among mammals, raising concerns about their pandemic potential. Building on recently published deep mutational scanning data 1 , we show that hemagglutinin retains structural plasticity to increase acid stability through independent mechanisms, including modulation of electrostatic interactions, hydrogen-bonding networks and hydrophobic packing that may facilitate human adaptation. These findings illustrate how structural analyses can strengthen genomic surveillance for pandemic risk assessment.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨禽流感A(H5N1)病毒血凝素的结构可塑性如何增强酸稳定性,从而可能促进其在人类中的适应。摘要 高致病性禽流感A(H5N1)病毒正在扩大其在哺乳动物中的宿主范围,引发了对其大流行潜力的担忧。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是对禽流感A(H5N1)病毒血凝素突变的计算机模拟分析,重点关注可能增强酸稳定性的结构变化。基于最近发表的深度突变扫描数据1,我们表明血凝素通过独立机制保持结构可塑性以增强酸稳定性,包括调节静电相互作用、氢键网络和疏水堆积,这些机制可能促进病毒在人类中的适应。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究采用计算方法分析禽流感A(H5N1)病毒血凝素的pH稳定序列突变,考察静电相互作用、氢键网络和疏水堆积等结构特征。
elements_zh.main_results: 本研究发现,血凝素可以通过结构可塑性增强酸稳定性,涉及静电相互作用、氢键网络和疏水堆积等机制。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为展示了结构分析如何增强对大流行风险评估的理解。这些发现展示了结构分析如何增强基因组监测以评估大流行风险。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为基因组监测工作提供信息,以更好地评估流感病毒相关的大流行风险。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于计算机模拟分析,可能无法完全反映体内动态。

papers.title: Influenza infection in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis of global prevalence and association with exacerbations
papers.abstract: Influenza infection is a potential contributor to chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) morbidity, particularly during exacerbations. However, reported prevalence and its association with exacerbations vary across studies. A systematic review and meta-analysis were conducted to estimate the prevalence of influenza in COPD and exacerbated COPD patients and to evaluate its association with exacerbations. Random-effects models with logit transformation were used to pool prevalence estimates and odds ratios (ORs). Subgroup analyses were performed by influenza type and subtype, patient setting, data collection period, and geographic region. Heterogeneity and publication bias were assessed using standard methods. A total of 50 studies on COPD, 44 studies on exacerbated COPD, and 4 case-control studies were included. The pooled prevalence of influenza was 10.6% (95% CI: 8.2–13.3% and I2 = 98.7% for overall COPD and 95% CI: 8.4–13.2% and I2 = 93.7% for exacerbated COPD) in both COPD and exacerbated COPD populations. Influenza A was the predominant type, followed by influenza B and C. Among subtypes, H1N1 and H3N2 showed comparable prevalence. The pooled OR for the association between influenza and exacerbation of COPD was 1.08 (95% CI: 0.48–2.46), indicating no significant association. Subgroup analyses by patient setting, temporal analysis, and geographic region did not demonstrate statistically significant differences. The pooled estimates should therefore be interpreted as averages across heterogeneous settings rather than as universally applicable prevalence values. Evidence regarding an association with COPD exacerbation remains inconclusive.

papers.abstract_zh: 流感感染是慢性阻塞性肺病 (COPD) 发病的潜在因素,特别是在病情恶化期间。然而,不同研究报告的 患病率 及其与病情加重的关系各不相同。进行了系统回顾和荟萃分析,以估计 COPD 和 COPD 加重患者中流感的 患病率,并评估其与加重的关联。使用 Logit 变换的随机效应模型来汇集 患病率 估计值和比值比 (OR)。按流感类型和亚型、患者环境、数据收集周期和地理区域进行亚组分析。使用标准方法评估异质性和发表偏倚。总共纳入了 50 项关于 COPD 的研究、44 项关于急性 COPD 的研究以及 4 项病例对照研究。在 COPD 和急性 COPD 人群中,流感的汇总 患病率 均为 10.6%(总体 COPD 的 95% CI:8.2–13.3% 和 I2 = 98.7%,急性 COPD 的 95% CI:8.4–13.2% 和 I2 = 93.7%)。甲型流感是主要类型,其次是乙型和丙型流感。在亚型中,H1N1 和 H3N2 表现出可比的 患病率。流感与 COPD 恶化之间关联的汇总 OR 为 1.08(95% CI:0.48-2.46),表明没有显着关联。按患者环境、时间分析和地理区域进行的亚组分析并未显示出统计学上的显着差异。因此,汇总估计值应解释为异构设置的平均值,而不是普遍适用的 患病率 值。关于与慢性阻塞性肺病恶化相关的证据仍无定论。

papers.title: Effects of Age and Birth Cohort on Influenza A Virus Subtype-Specific Hospitalization Rates, United States, 2010-2025.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Older individuals (≥65 years) are at greatest risk of severe influenza requiring hospitalization. Since 2009, influenza-associated hospitalization rates during A(H1N1)pdm09-predominant influenza seasons have been lower than during A(H3N2)-predominant seasons. METHODS: Using laboratory-confirmed influenza hospitalization rates from US population-based surveillance, we investigated the relative A(H1N1)pdm09 to A(H3N2) hospitalization rate ratios by patient year of age and birth cohort from 2010 through 2025. RESULTS: Results suggest partial protection against A(H1N1)pdm09 hospitalizations relative to A(H3N2) hospitalizations among patients born before 1945 (pre-1945 birth cohorts) and among individuals born during 1994 through 2009. Impact of partial protection against A(H1N1)pdm09-associated hospitalizations has diminished over time among older adults, contributing to elevated influenza hospitalization rates during the 2024-2025 influenza season. CONCLUSIONS: Our findings suggest that influenza A hospitalization rates may increase during future influenza seasons when influenza A(H3N2) and A(H1N1) viruses circulate or following the emergence of novel A(H1N1)pdm09-like viruses.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate how age and birth cohort affect hospitalization rates for specific influenza A subtypes, particularly highlighting the risk differences between A(H1N1)pdm09 and A(H3N2) viruses.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used laboratory-confirmed influenza hospitalization rates from US population-based surveillance, analyzing data from 2010 through 2025 across different age groups and birth cohorts.
analysis.methods: The researchers calculated the relative A(H1N1)pdm09 to A(H3N2) hospitalization rate ratios by patient year of age and birth cohort using data from the US population-based surveillance system.
analysis.main_results: Results indicated partial protection against A(H1N1)pdm09 hospitalizations compared to A(H3N2) hospitalizations among individuals born before 1945 and those born between 1994 and 2009. The impact of this partial protection has decreased over time, contributing to higher hospitalization rates during the 2024-2025 influenza season.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted these findings as suggesting that the relative protection against A(H1N1)pdm09 may be waning, which could lead to increased hospitalization rates if A(H3N2) and A(H1N1)pdm09 viruses co-circulate or if new A(H1N1)pdm09-like viruses emerge.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings can inform public health strategies for influenza surveillance and risk assessment, particularly in older adults, by highlighting the changing dynamics of hospitalization rates associated with different influenza subtypes.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on surveillance data, which may not capture all relevant factors, and the diminishing impact of partial protection over time. The evidence is moderate in strength due to these limitations.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines how age and birth cohort influence hospitalization rates for specific influenza A subtypes in the United States from 2010 to 2025. It highlights that individuals born before 1945 and those born between 1994 and 2009 showed partial protection against A(H1N1)pdm09 hospitalizations compared to A(H3N2). However, this protection has diminished over time, contributing to elevated hospitalization rates during the 2024-2025 season. The authors suggest that future influenza seasons with co-circulation of A(H3N2) and A(H1N1)pdm09 or the emergence of novel A(H1N1)pdm09-like viruses may see increased hospitalization rates. The study's findings have implications for public health surveillance and risk assessment, particularly for older adults. While the evidence is moderate in strength due to reliance on surveillance data, the study provides important insights into the changing dynamics of influenza hospitalization rates.

papers.title: Molecular Surveillance and Partial Genetic Characterization of Low-Pathogenic Avian Influenza A Viruses in Migrating Birds from Ukraine
papers.abstract: Wild migratory birds are the principal natural reservoir of influenza A viruses (IAVs) and play a central role in their evolution and global dissemination. Ukraine lies along the Black Sea–Mediterranean Flyway, making surveillance of avian influenza viruses in wild birds essential within a One Health framework, although genomic data from the region remain limited. Between October 2025 and January 2026, 604 cloacal and oropharyngeal swabs and environmental fecal samples were collected from migratory birds and mixed-species flocks in the Tuzlivski lymany National Nature Park and surrounding areas, together with samples from nearby domestic poultry. Influenza A virus was detected by real-time RT-PCR targeting the matrix gene, followed by H5/H7 screening, Oxford Nanopore sequencing of complete hemagglutinin genes, and phylogenetic analysis. Influenza A virus RNA was identified in 30/604 samples (4.97%), whereas all samples were negative for H5 and H7 subtypes. Complete hemagglutinin sequences revealed three low-pathogenic subtypes (H1, H4, and H6) that clustered within established Eurasian lineages closely related to contemporary avian viruses circulating across Europe, Asia, and North America. No influenza A virus or Newcastle disease virus was detected in domestic poultry. These findings provide an important genomic baseline for avian influenza surveillance in Ukraine and demonstrate the value of portable nanopore sequencing and integrated One Health surveillance for monitoring viral diversity and supporting early detection of emerging influenza threats.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 野生候鸟是甲型流感病毒(IAV)的主要天然储存宿主,并在其进化和全球传播中发挥着核心作用。乌克兰位于黑海-地中海迁徙路线沿线,因此野生鸟类中的禽流感病毒 监测 在“同一个健康”框架内至关重要,尽管该地区的基因组数据仍然有限。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: Between October 2025 and January 2026, 604 cloacal and oropharyngeal swabs and environmental fecal samples were collected from migratory birds and mixed-species flocks in the Tuzlivski lymany National Nature Park and surrounding areas, together with samples from nearby domestic poultry.
elements_zh.methods: 通过针对基质基因的实时 RT-PCR 检测甲型流感病毒,然后进行 H5/H7 筛选、完整血凝素基因的牛津纳米孔测序以及系统发育分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 30/604 个样本 (4.97%) 中鉴定出甲型流感病毒 RNA,而所有样本的 H5 和 H7 亚型均为阴性。完整的血凝素序列揭示了三种低致病性亚型(H1、H4 和 H6),它们聚集在已建立的欧亚谱系中,与欧洲、亚洲和北美流行的当代禽病毒密切相关。家禽中未检测到甲型流感病毒和新城疫病毒。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现为乌克兰禽流感 监测 提供了重要的基因组基线,并证明了便携式纳米孔测序和集成 One Health 监测 在监测病毒多样性和支持早期检测新出现的流感威胁方面的价值。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可为 监测 战略提供信息,并支持及早发现新出现的流感威胁,为全球监测和控制禽流感的努力做出贡献。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到样本量的限制,并且没有检测到 H5 和 H7 亚型,这可能表明抽样策略存在偏差。证据强度中等。

papers.title: Mapping global transcript isoform landscapes of influenza A virus infection and interferon stimulation reveals RNA-binding protein networks associated with immune remodeling
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Infected cells rapidly adapt their transcriptional profile to upregulate genes that limit pathogen replication and promote inflammation. Viruses also induce widespread changes in host gene expression, and both host and virus further remodel the transcriptome through targeted mRNA degradation, modulation of alternative splicing, and alterations at transcript 5’ and 3’ ends. The complexity of the response to infection makes it difficult to understand which transcriptional changes are driven by the virus and which reflect the host antiviral program. Short-read RNA sequencing has been the primary tool for studying these changes, but its inability to resolve fulllength transcript isoforms limits isoform switching-based analyses, narrowing our understanding of how transcript usage shapes immunity. Here we profiled the host transcriptome in response to interferon-β treatment or influenza A virus infection using both short- and long-read RNA sequencing analyzed with the SQANTI3 pipeline. Because isoform switching and transcript abundance change are distinct regulatory events, we focused our analysis on differential transcript usage to uncover a layer of transcriptome remodeling that standard expression analysis cannot detect. Pathway analysis revealed distinct regulons for genes undergoing transcriptional upregulation compared with those undergoing isoform switching. These data provide a rich resource for querying the isoform changes underlying shared and distinct transcriptional programs triggered by viral infection or innate immune stimulation. To identify putative mechanisms coordinating these stimulation-dependent isoform changes, we integrated 232 eCLIP datasets and found a small set of RNA-binding proteins localized at these isoform switches, including DDX3X. Comparing the responses to interferon and to virus highlighted RNA-binding proteins associated with infection-dependent immune remodeling. Altogether, these results demonstrate the value of hybrid sequencing for deciphering the post-transcriptional regulatory code active during the antiviral response.

source_records.title: Mapping global transcript isoform landscapes of influenza A virus infection and interferon stimulation reveals RNA-binding protein networks associated with immune remodeling
source_records.abstract: ABSTRACT Infected cells rapidly adapt their transcriptional profile to upregulate genes that limit pathogen replication and promote inflammation. Viruses also induce widespread changes in host gene expression, and both host and virus further remodel the transcriptome through targeted mRNA degradation, modulation of alternative splicing, and alterations at transcript 5’ and 3’ ends. The complexity of the response to infection makes it difficult to understand which transcriptional changes are driven by the virus and which reflect the host antiviral program. Short-read RNA sequencing has been the primary tool for studying these changes, but its inability to resolve fulllength transcript isoforms limits isoform switching-based analyses, narrowing our understanding of how transcript usage shapes immunity. Here we profiled the host transcriptome in response to interferon-β treatment or influenza A virus infection using both short- and long-read RNA sequencing analyzed with the SQANTI3 pipeline. Because isoform switching and transcript abundance change are distinct regulatory events, we focused our analysis on differential transcript usage to uncover a layer of transcriptome remodeling that standard expression analysis cannot detect. Pathway analysis revealed distinct regulons for genes undergoing transcriptional upregulation compared with those undergoing isoform switching. These data provide a rich resource for querying the isoform changes underlying shared and distinct transcriptional programs triggered by viral infection or innate immune stimulation. To identify putative mechanisms coordinating these stimulation-dependent isoform changes, we integrated 232 eCLIP datasets and found a small set of RNA-binding proteins localized at these isoform switches, including DDX3X. Comparing the responses to interferon and to virus highlighted RNA-binding proteins associated with infection-dependent immune remodeling. Altogether, these results demonstrate the value of hybrid sequencing for deciphering the post-transcriptional regulatory code active during the antiviral response.

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results can inform future studies on the mechanisms of immune remodeling during viral infections and may contribute to the development of targeted therapies or interventions that modulate transcript usage for improved antiviral outcomes.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the transcriptional and post-transcriptional changes in host cells during influenza A virus infection and interferon-β stimulation. The research highlights the complexity of the immune response and the limitations of short-read RNA sequencing in capturing full-length transcript isoforms. By integrating long-read sequencing and eCLIP datasets, the study identifies RNA-binding proteins, such as DDX3X, that play a role in infection-dependent immune remodeling. The findings reveal distinct regulons for genes undergoing transcriptional upregulation versus isoform switching, providing a valuable resource for understanding the molecular mechanisms underlying antiviral immunity. The study's use of hybrid sequencing methods enhances the interpretation of the post-transcriptional regulatory code, offering new insights into how transcript usage shapes immune responses. However, the study's reliance on sequencing techniques and the integration of datasets may limit its generalizability, though the evidence is considered strong due to the comprehensive approach.

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果可以为未来关于病毒感染期间免疫重塑机制的研究提供信息,并可能有助于开发调节转录本使用以改善 抗病毒药物 结果的靶向治疗或干预措施。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要:受感染的细胞迅速调整其转录谱,上调限制病原体复制并促进炎症的基因。病毒还诱导 宿主 基因表达的广泛变化,并且 宿主 和病毒都通过靶向 mRNA 降解、选择性剪接的调节以及转录物 5' 和 3' 末端的改变进一步重塑转录组。对感染反应的复杂性使得很难理解哪些转录变化是由病毒驱动的,哪些转录变化反映了 宿主 抗病毒药物 程序。短读长 RNA 测序一直是研究这些变化的主要工具,但它无法解析全长转录本异构体,限制了基于异构体转换的分析,缩小了我们对转录本使用如何影响免疫的理解。在这里,我们使用 SQANTI3 管道分析的短读长和长读长 RNA 测序来分析响应干扰素-β 治疗 或甲型流感病毒感染的 宿主 转录组。由于异构体转换和转录本丰度变化是不同的调控事件,因此我们将分析重点放在差异转录本使用上,以揭示标准表达分析无法检测到的转录组重塑层。通路分析揭示了与进行异构体转换的基因相比,进行转录上调的基因具有不同的调节子。这些数据提供了丰富的资源,用于查询由病毒感染或先天免疫刺激触发的共享和不同转录程序背后的亚型变化。为了确定协调这些刺激依赖性异构体变化的假定机制,我们整合了 232 个 eCLIP 数据集,并发现了一小部分位于这些异构体开关处的 RNA 结合蛋白,包括 DDX3X。比较对干扰素和病毒的反应,突出显示与感染依赖性免疫重塑相关的 RNA 结合蛋白。总而言之,这些结果证明了混合测序对于破译 抗病毒药物 反应期间活跃的转录后调控代码的价值。

papers.title: A Monoclonal Antibody Targeting mGluR2 Inhibits H9 Subtype Influenza A Virus Infection In Vitro
papers.abstract: Metabotropic glutamate receptor 2 (mGluR2) is a critical endocytic receptor for influenza A virus (IAV) entry, making it an attractive target for host-directed antiviral interventions. A recombinant truncated fragment of mGluR2 was expressed and purified from HEK293F cells in the present investigation. Immunization of BALB/c mice followed by splenocyte fusion yielded three stable hybridoma clones: 1G3B2, 2D5A9, and 4E1C6. All three monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) exhibited strong binding affinity to both denatured and native forms of mGluR2 in Western blot and immunofluorescence assays. In vitro neutralization assays revealed that clone 1G3B2 reduced H9 subtype IAV titers by approximately 7.7 folds and suppressed intracellular viral antigen expression in a dose-dependent manner. Clones 2D5A9 and 4E1C6, while showing no viral blocking efficacy, are valuable as research tools for Western blot and IFA applications. Genetic sequencing of 1G3B2 resolved its heavy and light chain variable regions, identifying a unique, prolonged heavy-chain CDR3 loop (TRHPVNNWAWFAY). This work reports three mAbs against mGluR2 and 1G3B2 could serve as a candidate agent for developing host-directed anti-influenza therapeutics.

papers.title: Influenza A Virus RNA Polymerase Is Enriched on the Chromatin of Innate Immune Response Genes
papers.abstract: The influenza A virus hijacks host cell machinery by “snatching” molecular caps from cellular RNAs to prime its own transcription. While this process is typically associated with the beginning of genes, this study reveals that the viral RNA polymerase exerts a far-reaching influence on host gene expression. Using genome-wide mapping and comparative pathway analyses, we show that viral polymerase (FluPol) recruitment is decoupled from general host transcriptional activity; instead, FluPol is markedly enriched at a distinct subset of promoters and enhancers associated with defense-related pathways. Beyond the initiation site, FluPol remains associated with host transcripts throughout elongation, extending into downstream-of-gene (DoG) regions. It further accumulates at gene ends, potentially contributing to widespread defects in transcription termination. By remaining linked to host transcripts across the entire gene body, FluPol could extend its opportunity for cap-snatching and impair the recycling of cellular transcription machinery. Together, these findings demonstrate how FluPol accumulation across key cellular defense loci spans from initiation through to termination, driving host transcriptional attenuation.

elements_en.main_results: FluPol remains associated with host transcripts throughout elongation, extending into downstream-of-gene (DoG) regions, and further accumulates at gene ends, potentially contributing to widespread defects in transcription termination.
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate how FluPol accumulation across key cellular defense loci spans from initiation through to termination, driving host transcriptional attenuation, which is a novel insight into the mechanisms of influenza A virus infection.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究采用基因组全基因组映射和比较通路分析,以探讨病毒RNA聚合酶(FluPol)在与防御相关通路相关的宿主基因启动子和增强子区域的招募情况。
elements_zh.methods: 采用基因组全基因组映射和比较通路分析,以展示FluPol的招募与一般的宿主转录活性脱钩,并且其更富集于与防御相关通路相关的特定启动子和增强子区域。
elements_zh.main_results: FluPol在整个转录延伸过程中持续与宿主转录本结合,延伸至基因下游区域(DoG),并在基因末端进一步积累,可能造成广泛转录终止缺陷。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,FluPol在关键细胞防御位点的积累贯穿从启动到终止的全过程,驱动宿主转录衰减,这是对流感A病毒感染机制的新见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能为监测、诊断和治疗策略提供信息,通过强调在流感A病毒感染中靶向病毒RNA聚合酶的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的发现受到基因组全基因组映射技术的限制,可能无法全面捕捉FluPol与宿主转录本的相互作用。由于依赖这些技术以及需要进一步验证,证据强度中等。

papers.title_zh: 流感A病毒RNA聚合酶在先天免疫应答基因染色质中富集
papers.source_body_en: The influenza A virus hijacks host cell machinery by “snatching” molecular caps from cellular RNAs to prime its own transcription. While this process is typically associated with the beginning of genes, this study reveals that the viral RNA polymerase exerts a far-reaching influence on host gene expression. Using genome-wide mapping and comparative pathway analyses, we show that viral polymerase (FluPol) recruitment is decoupled from general host transcriptional activity; instead, FluPol is markedly enriched at a distinct subset of promoters and enhancers associated with defense-related pathways. Beyond the initiation site, FluPol remains associated with host transcripts throughout elongation, extending into downstream-of-gene (DoG) regions. It further accumulates at gene ends, potentially contributing to widespread defects in transcription termination. By remaining linked to host transcripts across the entire gene body, FluPol could extend its opportunity for cap-snatching and impair the recycling of cellular transcription machinery. Together, these findings demonstrate how FluPol accumulation across key cellular defense loci spans from initiation through to termination, driving host transcriptional attenuation.
papers.abstract_zh: 流感A病毒通过‘劫持’细胞RNA的分子帽来启动自身的转录,从而利用宿主细胞机制。尽管这一过程通常与基因的起始位点相关联,但本研究揭示了病毒RNA聚合酶(FluPol)对宿主基因表达的广泛影响。通过基因组全基因组映射和比较通路分析,我们发现病毒聚合酶的招募与一般的宿主转录活性脱钩;相反,FluPol显著富集于与防御相关通路相关的特定启动子和增强子区域。在基因起始位点之后,FluPol持续与宿主转录本结合,延伸至基因下游区域(DoG)。它进一步在基因末端积累,可能造成广泛转录终止缺陷。通过在整个基因体内持续与宿主转录本结合,FluPol可能延长其劫持分子帽的机会,并干扰细胞转录机制的回收。综上所述,这些发现表明FluPol在关键细胞防御位点的积累贯穿从启动到终止的全过程,驱动宿主转录衰减。

papers.title: Sex differences in vaccine-induced neuraminidase cross-recognition impact H5N1 dissemination to the lower respiratory tract in mice.
papers.abstract: H5N1 vaccines have been poorly immunogenic in humans, creating a challenge for vaccine development. Seasonal influenza vaccines offer some cross-protection against H5N1, but there has been no consideration of whether protection differs between the sexes. We investigated sex differences in antibody responses following receipt of either beta-propiolactone inactivated whole virus H1N1 or H5N1 (LAIV backbone) vaccines in C57BL/6 mice. Using systems serology assays, vaccination induced strong homologous and heterologous antibody responses, with females generating greater IgG titers than males against whole virus H1N1 and H5N1, which was primarily mediated by greater IgG responses to neuraminidase (NA) than hemagglutinin (HA) protein. Cross-reactive H5N1 IgG titers were greater among H1N1-vaccinated females, and primarily mediated by greater N1-specific IgG titers. IgG2b and IgG2c were the primary antibody isotypes generated in response to these vaccines, with females having greater IgG2b titers and enhanced binding to FcγRIV for avian and human NA than males following either homologous or heterologous vaccination. Antibody-dependent complement deposition was measured as an FcR-mediated non-neutralizing response against HA and NA and was more robust among H1N1 and H5N1 vaccinated females than their male counterparts in response to homologous HA only. Vaccinated females tended to have greater neutralizing antibody titers than males against the homologous vaccine strain, with limited cross-neutralizing antibodies detected in either sexes. Neuraminidase inhibition titers were greater in vaccinated females than males against the heterologous virus following H1N1 vaccination and against both the vaccine and heterologous viruses following H5N1 vaccination. When H1N1 and H5N1 vaccinated mice were challenged with a lethal dose of A/Texas/37/2024 H5N1, all H5N1 vaccinated mice were protected, regardless of sex. Among H1N1 vaccinated mice, while both sexes were protected against disease, H1N1 vaccinated females restricted virus to the upper respiratory tract and had lower pulmonary virus titers than males at 3 days post challenge. These findings highlight that sex differences in vaccine-induced NA-specific antibody responses are associated with differential respiratory dissemination of H5N1 and that sex should be considered in studies of vaccine-induced cross-reactive influenza immunity.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates sex differences in antibody responses to seasonal influenza vaccines, specifically H1N1 and H5N1, in C57BL/6 mice. It highlights that females generate greater IgG titers against these vaccines, primarily due to stronger neuraminidase (NA)-specific responses compared to males. The results show that vaccine-induced NA-specific antibodies are associated with reduced H5N1 dissemination to the lower respiratory tract in females. These findings suggest that sex should be considered in vaccine research for cross-reactive influenza immunity. The study uses systems serology assays and measures antibody-dependent complement deposition as a non-neutralizing response. While the results indicate sex-based differences in immune responses, the evidence does not report specific limitations or a formal assessment of evidence strength.

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,疫苗诱导的针对唾液酸酶的抗体反应在性别间的差异与H5N1在呼吸道中的不同扩散有关,并提示在研究疫苗诱导的交叉反应性流感免疫时应考虑性别因素。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,在疫苗的研发和评估中应考虑性别因素,以更好地理解免疫应答并可能优化疫苗策略,特别是在针对H5N1的交叉反应性流感免疫方面。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 提供的证据未报告研究设计或证据强度评估的局限性。

papers.title: ATTITUDES AND PRACTICES TOWARDS COVID-19 AND SEASONAL FLU VACCINES AND VACCINATION IN THE GENERAL POPULATION AND AMONG MEDICAL PROFESSIONALS
papers.abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has led to the development of several types of vaccines, among which messenger RNA (mRNA)-based vaccines have represented a significant breakthrough. This study aimed to evaluate attitudes towards COVID-19 and seasonal influenza vaccination among the general population and individuals with a medical background. A questionnaire was developed to collect sociodemographic data, personal health information, vaccination status, and information on participants’ attitudes towards and knowledge of vaccines. The profile of the typical participant was an employed woman with tertiary education, living with another person in an urban area and reporting generally good health. The typical participant had received at least two doses of the Sputnik V vaccine. Participants generally expressed favourable attitudes towards regular COVID-19 vaccination. The results showed no apparent differences between participants with and without a medical background regarding vaccine choice, the decision to receive a third dose, or seasonal influenza vaccination. Similarly, no apparent differences were observed in attitudes towards the AstraZeneca vaccine or mandatory COVID-19 vaccination between respondents with and without a medical background.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated attitudes towards COVID-19 and seasonal influenza vaccination among the general population and medical professionals. It found that there were no apparent differences in vaccine choice, third-dose decisions, or seasonal influenza vaccination between the two groups. The research highlights the importance of understanding public perception of vaccines, which can inform public health strategies. However, the study is limited by its reliance on self-reported data and its abstract-only nature, which may affect the reliability of the findings. The results suggest that attitudes towards vaccination are consistent across different professional backgrounds, indicating a potential for uniform messaging in health promotion.

analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform public health strategies by suggesting that targeted communication efforts may not need to differentiate between medical professionals and the general population in promoting vaccination.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on self-reported data and its abstract-only nature, which may affect the strength of the evidence.

papers.title_zh: 关于冠状病毒病2019年(COVID-19)和季节性流感疫苗和疫苗接种在一般人群和医疗专业人员中的态度和做法
papers.source_body_en: The COVID-19 pandemic has led to the development of several types of vaccines, among which messenger RNA (mRNA)-based vaccines have represented a significant breakthrough. This study aimed to evaluate attitudes towards COVID-19 and seasonal influenza vaccination among the general population and individuals with a medical background. A questionnaire was developed to collect sociodemographic data, personal health information, vaccination status, and information on participants’ attitudes towards and knowledge of vaccines. The profile of the typical participant was an employed woman with tertiary education, living with another person in an urban area and reporting generally good health. The typical participant had received at least two doses of the Sputnik V vaccine. Participants generally expressed favourable attitudes towards regular COVID-19 vaccination. The results showed no apparent differences between participants with and without a medical background regarding vaccine choice, the decision to receive a third dose, or seasonal influenza vaccination. Similarly, no apparent differences were observed in attitudes towards the AstraZeneca vaccine or mandatory COVID-19 vaccination between respondents with and without a medical background.

papers.title: Recurring Temporal Association Between Influenza A Epidemics and Subsequent Influenza B Dominance in Post‐Pandemic Korea, 2022−2026
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Post‐pandemic influenza dynamics have shown unusual patterns globally. We investigated the re‐emergence and recurrent seasonal dominance of influenza B in Korea across three post‐pandemic seasons (2022−2026). We analyzed 157 consecutive weeks of national sentinel surveillance data (K‐SenS, Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency), covering September 2022 to August 2025, plus preliminary data through Week 10 of 2026. Influenza B predominance was defined as weeks with > 50% influenza B among total influenza detections; a sensitivity analysis required overall influenza activity > 5%. Influenza B activity remained minimal during the 2022−23 season (mean proportion 3.3%; peak 25.3%) and never reached predominance. Two complete predominance episodes followed influenza A epidemics: after the 2023−24 epidemic (co‐circulating A/H1N1pdm09 and A/H3N2; peak ILI 61.3/1000), B predominance began January 2024 and persisted 23 weeks (peak 100%); after the 2024−25A/H1N1pdm09‐dominant epidemic (peak ILI 99.8/1000), it began February 2025 and accumulated 20 weeks over two periods with a brief interruption (peak 100%). Onset occurred 5−8 weeks after the influenza A peak by ILI (6−8 weeks virologically) in all three episodes, unaffected by threshold choice. A third episode following the 2025−26A/H3N2 epidemic was ongoing as of March 2026 (onset 7 weeks after the A peak). In post‐pandemic Korea, influenza B repeatedly established seasonal dominance 5−8 weeks after influenza A epidemics across three consecutive seasons. This recurring temporal pattern may have implications for influenza surveillance, clinical preparedness, and vaccine strategy, though its underlying mechanism remains unestablished.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the recurring temporal association between influenza A epidemics and subsequent influenza B dominance in post-pandemic Korea from 2022 to 2026. Using national sentinel surveillance data, it found that influenza B activity remained minimal during the 2022−23 season but established dominance in two subsequent seasons following influenza A epidemics. A third episode following the 2025−26A/H3N2 epidemic was ongoing as of March 2026 (onset 7 weeks after the A peak). In post‐pandemic Korea, influenza B repeatedly established seasonal dominance 5−8 weeks after influenza A epidemics across three consecutive seasons. This recurring temporal pattern may have implications for influenza surveillance, clinical preparedness, and vaccine strategy, though its underlying mechanism remains unestablished.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 流感大流行后的流感动态在全球范围内表现出异常模式。我们研究了2022−2026年韩国流感大流行后三个季节中流感B的重新出现和季节性主导现象。我们分析了韩国疾病控制与预防机构(K‐SenS)提供的157周连续国家哨兵监测数据,覆盖2022年9月至2025年8月,以及2026年第10周的初步数据。将流感B主导定义为流感B在总流感检测中占比超过50%的周数;敏感性分析要求总体流感活动强度超过5%。在2022−23流感季节,流感B活动水平保持较低(平均占比3.3%;峰值25.3%),从未达到主导地位。在两次流感A疫情之后出现了完整的流感B主导期:在2023−24年流感A疫情(同时流行A/H1N1pdm09和A/H3N2;ILI峰值61.3/1000)后,流感B主导始于2024年1月并持续了23周(峰值100%);在2024−25年以A/H1N1pdm09为主导的流感疫情(ILI峰值99.8/1000)后,流感B主导始于2025年2月,并在两个时间段内累计持续了20周,中间有一次短暂中断(峰值100%)。在所有三个案例中,流感B主导的开始时间均在流感A疫情高峰后5−8周(病毒学上为6−8周),且不受阈值选择的影响。在2025−26年以A/H3N2为主导的流感疫情之后,流感B主导现象仍在持续(截至2026年3月,主导开始时间为A疫情高峰后7周)。在流感大流行后的韩国,流感B在三个连续季节中均在流感A疫情高峰后5−8周建立了季节性主导地位。这种反复出现的时间模式可能对流感监测、临床准备以及疫苗策略产生影响,尽管其潜在机制尚未明确。

papers.title: Influenza vaccine effectiveness against influenza A-associated hospitalization and severe in-hospital outcomes among adults in the United States, 2024-2025.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: The U.S. 2024-2025 influenza season was characterized by sustained elevated activity from November 2024-April 2025, with circulation of both influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 and A(H3N2), the latter of which included some antigenically drifted viruses. METHODS: From October 1, 2024, to April 30, 2025, a multistate respiratory virus surveillance network enrolled adults hospitalized with acute respiratory illness in 26 U.S. Influenza vaccine effectiveness (VE) against influenza-associated hospitalization and severe in-hospital outcomes was estimated using a test-negative study. The odds of influenza vaccination among influenza-positive case patients and influenza-negative control patients were compared using multivariable logistic regression; VE was calculated as (1 - adjusted odds ratio for vaccination) × 100, expressed as a percent. RESULTS: The 2024-2025 seasonal influenza vaccine was effective against influenza-associated hospitalization (VE: 40% [95% confidence interval (CI): 32%-47%]), consistent across age group and influenza type/A subtype. Influenza vaccination also reduced the overall risk of all severe in-hospital outcomes evaluated, including standard oxygen therapy (VE: 41% [95% CI: 31%-50%]), non-invasive advanced respiratory support (VE: 38% [95% CI: 19%-52%]), invasive organ support (VE: 58% [95% CI: 44%-69%]), ICU admission (VE: 58% [95% CI: 47%-67%]), and death (VE: 52% [95% CI: 18%-71%]) with effectiveness varying by influenza A subtype and age. CONCLUSIONS: Influenza vaccination reduced the risk of influenza-related hospitalization and severe in-hospital outcomes in adults during the severe 2024-2025 influenza season compared with those not vaccinated.

source_records.abstract: BACKGROUND: The U.S. 2024-2025 influenza season was characterized by sustained elevated activity from November 2024-April 2025, with circulation of both influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 and A(H3N2), the latter of which included some antigenically drifted viruses. METHODS: From October 1, 2024, to April 30, 2025, a multistate respiratory virus surveillance network enrolled adults hospitalized with acute respiratory illness in 26 U.S. Influenza vaccine effectiveness (VE) against influenza-associated hospitalization and severe in-hospital outcomes was estimated using a test-negative study. The odds of influenza vaccination among influenza-positive case patients and influenza-negative control patients were compared using multivariable logistic regression; VE was calculated as (1 - adjusted odds ratio for vaccination) × 100, expressed as a percent. RESULTS: The 2024-2025 seasonal influenza vaccine was effective against influenza-associated hospitalization (VE: 40% [95% confidence interval (CI): 32%-47%]), consistent across age group and influenza type/A subtype. Influenza vaccination also reduced the overall risk of all severe in-hospital outcomes evaluated, including standard oxygen therapy (VE: 41% [95% CI: 31%-50%]), non-invasive advanced respiratory support (VE: 38% [95% CI: 19%-52%]), invasive organ support (VE: 58% [95% CI: 44%-69%]), ICU admission (VE: 58% [95% CI: 47%-67%]), and death (VE: 52% [95% CI: 18%-71%]) with effectiveness varying by influenza A subtype and age. CONCLUSIONS: Influenza vaccination reduced the risk of influenza-related hospitalization and severe in-hospital outcomes in adults during the severe 2024-2025 influenza season compared with those not vaccinated.

analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate that the vaccine provided moderate protection against hospitalization and severe outcomes, with effectiveness differing by virus subtype and age, highlighting the importance of vaccine composition and population-specific responses.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results inform public health strategies for seasonal influenza vaccination, emphasizing the need for updated vaccine formulations and targeted vaccination efforts in high-risk groups.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the effectiveness of the 2024-2025 seasonal influenza vaccine against influenza-associated hospitalization and severe in-hospital outcomes among adults in the United States. The research was conducted during the 2024-2025 influenza season, with a focus on the circulating influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 and A(H3N2) viruses. Using a test-negative study design, the authors compared vaccination rates between influenza-positive case patients and influenza-negative control patients. The vaccine demonstrated effectiveness against hospitalization (VE: 40% [95% CI: 32%-47%]) and severe outcomes, including ICU admission (VE: 58% [95% CI: 47%-67%]) and death (VE: 52% [95% CI: 18%-71%]). The results were consistent across age groups and virus subtypes, indicating the vaccine's moderate protective effect. The study's findings have important implications for public health, highlighting the need for updated vaccine formulations and targeted vaccination strategies. However, the study is limited by its test-negative design and potential biases in self-reported vaccination status, which may affect the generalizability of the results.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:2024-2025年美国流感季的特点是从2024年11月至2025年4月持续高活动水平,流感病毒甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09和甲型H3N2流感病毒同时流行,后者包括一些抗原漂移的病毒株。方法:从2024年10月1日到2025年4月30日,一个多州呼吸道病毒监测网络纳入了美国26个州因急性呼吸道疾病住院的成年人。通过测试阴性研究设计,评估了2024-2025年流感疫苗对流感相关住院和住院期间严重结局的有效性。使用多变量逻辑回归比较了流感阳性病例患者和流感阴性对照患者的疫苗接种接种率比值;有效性(VE)计算为(调整后的疫苗接种比值比)×100,以百分比表示。结果:2024-2025年流感疫苗对流感相关住院的有效性为40%(95%置信区间[CI]:32%-47%),在不同年龄组和流感类型/亚型中保持一致。流感疫苗接种还降低了所有评估的住院期间严重结局的总体风险,包括标准氧疗(VE:41% [95% CI: 31%-50%])、非侵入性高级呼吸支持(VE:38% [95% CI: 19%-52%])、侵入性器官支持(VE:58% [95% CI: 44%-69%])、ICU入院(VE:58% [95% CI: 47%-67%])和死亡(VE:52% [95% CI: 18%-71%]),其有效性因流感A亚型和年龄组而异。结论:与未接种疫苗的人群相比,2024-2025年流感疫苗在严重流感季中降低了美国成年人流感相关住院和住院期间严重结局的风险。

papers.title: Coverage and appropriateness of influenza vaccination in adults ≥ 60 y: Provider contribution and adherence to Italian national recommendations.
papers.abstract: The aim of the present study is to evaluate the 2023/24 and 2024/25 influenza vaccination campaigns in Liguria (Italy), specifically analyzing how the transition toward a proximity-based model impacted vaccine appropriateness across different age groups (60-64 y, ≥65 y) and providers. Data regarding seasonal influenza vaccine administrations were extracted from the official Local Health Units (LHUs) immunization registries, which aggregate immunization records from different providers [LHUs, General Practitioners (GPs), pediatricians and community pharmacies]. To evaluate prescriptive appropriklateness, administered vaccines were cross-referenced with national guidelines based on the patient's age. A 6% overall decrease in coverage rates between the two seasons was recorded while the provider landscape shifted significantly. Unfortunately, while enhancing proximity (General Practitioners and pharmacies), this evolution introduced wide variability in prescriptive appropriateness. Our analysis reveals a persistent mismatch between national recommendations and real-world clinical practice and only 65% (2023/24 season) and 73% (2024/25 season) among ≥65 y individuals received enhanced vaccines. Strengthening clinical governance and targeted professional training for pharmacists and GPs is essential to ensure that the convenience of proximity-based vaccination does not compromise clinical efficacy through the use of sub-optimal vaccine platforms for high-risk cohorts.

papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在评估2023/24和2024/25年在意大利利古里亚地区流感疫苗接种接种活动,具体分析向基于就近接种模式的转变如何影响不同年龄组(60-64岁,≥65岁)和提供者的疫苗接种适宜性。关于季节性流感和疫苗接种的数据是从官方地方卫生单位(LHUs)的疫苗接种登记系统中提取的,该系统汇总了不同提供者(LHUs、全科医生(GPs)、儿科医生和社区药店)的疫苗接种记录。为评估处方适宜性,接种的疫苗与基于患者年龄的国家指南进行了交叉核对。在两个季节之间,总体接种率下降了6%,同时提供者格局发生了显著变化。不幸的是,尽管增强了就近性(全科医生和药店),这种进化却引入了处方适宜性方面的广泛差异。我们的分析揭示了国家建议与实际临床实践之间持续存在的不匹配,且在≥65岁人群中,仅有65%(2023/24季节)和73%(2024/25季节)接种了增强型疫苗。加强临床治理和针对药房及全科医生的专业培训至关重要,以确保基于就近接种的疫苗接种便利性不会因使用次优的疫苗平台而损害临床效果,特别是在高风险队列研究人群中。

papers.title: The Potential Public Health Benefit of mRNA-1010 for Influenza Among Older Adults ≥65 Years in the United States
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: Older adults are at high risk of influenza-related severe disease and complications. HD-IIV, currently recommended for adults [≥]65 years, is egg-based and may be subject to egg-adapted mutations. An mRNA-based vaccine for influenza, mRNA-1010, has been approved by the Food and Drug Administration. Given the clinical benefits observed in mRNA-1010 clinical trials and potential to avoid egg-adapted mutations, this analysis explores the clinical impact of mRNA-1010 compared to HD-IIV in those [≥]65 years in the United States. Methods: This study used a decision-analytic model of influenza infection and downstream outcomes to project influenza burden with each vaccine over a one-year timeframe. Vaccine coverage, HD-IIV vaccine effectiveness (VE) and influenza epidemiology was estimated based upon Centers for Disease Control and Prevention data. The relative VE (rVE) for mRNA-1010 vs. HD-IIV was modelled based on data from the clinical trial and published literature on the impact of egg adaptation. Results: The base-case analysis suggests mRNA-1010 may prevent an additional 232,200 symptomatic influenza infections, 130,000 outpatient cases, 21,100 influenza-related hospitalizations, and 2,200 influenza-related deaths compared to HD-IIV. The number needed to vaccination to prevent one hospitalization was 514 or mRNA-1010 vs no vaccine and 404 for HD-IIV versus no vaccine, for an incremental NNV of 110. Scenario and deterministic sensitivity analyses results indicate that clinical outcomes prevented by mRNA-1010 are most sensitive to influenza incidence and VE. Conclusions: mRNA-1010 may improve protection against influenza in US adults aged [≥]65 years, leading to meaningful reductions in the clinical influenza-related disease burden in older adults.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景/目标:65岁及以上老年人是流感相关严重疾病和并发症的高风险人群。目前推荐用于65岁及以上成年人的HD-IIV是一种基于鸡蛋的疫苗,可能受到蛋适应性突变的影响。一种基于mRNA的疫苗流感疫苗mRNA-1010已获得美国食品药品监督管理局批准。鉴于mRNA-1010临床试验中观察到的临床益处及其避免蛋适应性突变的潜力,本分析探讨了mRNA-1010与HD-IIV在65岁及以上美国人群中的临床影响。方法:本研究采用流感感染及其下游结果的决策分析模型,以一年的时间框架预测每种疫苗的流感负担。基于美国疾病控制与预防中心的数据,估计了疫苗的覆盖率、HD-IIV 疫苗的有效性(VE)以及流感流行病学。mRNA-1010与HD-IIV的相对VE(rVE)基于临床试验数据和关于蛋适应性影响的文献进行了建模。结果:基线分析表明,与HD-IIV相比,mRNA-1010可能额外预防232,200例流感症状感染、130,000例门诊病例、21,100例流感相关住院病例和2,200例流感相关死亡。为了预防一例住院病例,mRNA-1010所需的接种人数为514,而HD-IIV为404,增量的NNV为110。情景分析和确定性敏感性分析结果表明,mRNA-1010预防的临床结果最敏感于流感发病率和VE。结论:mRNA-1010可能提高美国65岁及以上成年人对流感的保护水平,从而显著降低老年人流感相关疾病的临床负担。科学意义和公共卫生意义:研究结果表明,mRNA-1010可能为减少老年人流感相关疾病负担提供更有效的策略,通过改善疫苗表现,可能提升公共卫生成果。局限性和证据强度:本研究基于决策分析模型,可能引入假设和不确定性。由于依赖模型预测和已发表文献,证据强度为中等。

papers.title: UNRAVELING INFLUENZA: FROM LABORATORY DIAGNOSIS TO CLINICAL AND EPIDEMIOLOGICAL IMPACT
papers.abstract: Introduction: Influenza is an enveloped, negative-sense, single-stranded RNA virus of the Orthomyxoviridae family, classified into types A, B, and C. Seasonal influenza remains a major cause of global morbidity and mortality. Objective: To describe the clinical and epidemiological characteristics of individuals with influenza infection and to assess microbiological findings. Methods: This study analyzed medical records of hospitalized and non-hospitalized individuals of all ages and genders evaluated in a Brazilian public healthcare service. Laboratory-confirmed Influenza cases identified by molecular testing between February 2024 and July 2025 were included. Clinical specimens consisted of nasopharyngeal swabs (n=95) and tracheal aspirates (n=3). Viral RNA was extracted using the KingFisher system (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Sweden). RT-qPCR assays were performed to detect SARS-CoV-2, respiratory syncytial virus, and Influenza A/B, including Influenza A typing, using the QuantStudio 5 platform (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Sweden). Ct values were recorded for viral load assessment. Clinical and epidemiological variables were analyzed. Results: Influenza A (H1N1) was the most frequently detected subtype (62.3%), followed by non-typed Influenza A (26.5%) and Influenza B (11.2%). Cough was reported in 82.6% of individuals. The most common comorbidities were chronic neurological disease (15.3%) and Down syndrome (11.2%). Influenza vaccination was reported by 17.4% of individuals, while 32.6% had received the COVID-19 vaccine. Antiviral therapy was administered to 6.2% of individuals, 37.8% required ventilatory support, 65.3% were hospitalized, and 34.7% were managed as outpatients. Ct values ≤35 were observed in 91.8% of samples collected within 10 days of symptom onset. Conclusions: The predominance of H1N1 highlights its epidemiological relevance. Expanding vaccination, surveillance, and timely antiviral use is essential to reduce disease severity and healthcare burden.
authors: GIOVANNA DE SOUZA TIBURCIO DA SILVA

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 季节性流感仍然是全球发病率和死亡率的主要原因。本研究旨在描述流感感染个体的临床和流行病学特征,并评估微生物学发现。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究分析了巴西公共医疗服务体系中所有年龄和性别住院及非住院个体的医疗记录。纳入了2024年2月至2025年7月期间通过分子检测确认的流感病例。临床样本包括鼻咽拭子(n=95)和气管吸引物(n=3)。
elements_zh.methods: 使用KingFisher系统(Thermo Fisher Scientific,瑞典)提取病毒RNA。通过QuantStudio 5平台(Thermo Fisher Scientific,瑞典)进行RT-qPCR检测,以检测SARS-CoV-2、呼吸道合胞病毒和流感A/B型,包括流感A型的分型。记录了Ct值以评估病毒载量。分析了临床和流行病学变量。
elements_zh.main_results: 甲型H1N1流感病毒(甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09)是最常检测到的亚型(62.3%),其次是未分型的甲型流感病毒(26.5%)和乙型流感病毒(11.2%)。82.6%的个体报告有咳嗽症状。最常见的合并症是慢性神经系统疾病(15.3%)和唐氏综合征(11.2%)。17.4%的个体报告感染了疫苗接种流感病毒,而32.6%的个体曾接种过COVID-19 疫苗疫苗。在发病后10天内采集的样本中,91.8%的Ct值≤35。6.2%的个体接受了抗病毒药物治疗,37.8%需要机械通气支持,65.3%住院治疗,34.7%作为门诊患者处理。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: H1N1型流感的主导地位突显了其流行病学意义。扩大疫苗接种、监测以及及时使用抗病毒药物治疗对于减轻疾病严重程度和医疗负担至关重要。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以用于制定针对性的疫苗接种策略,改进监测系统,并及时使用抗病毒药物治疗以减轻季节性流感的影响。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于医疗记录,未包含详细的实验室或统计程序。由于依赖观察性数据且缺乏实验对照,证据强度中等。

papers.title: From detection to prediction: Asymptomatic shedding-informed mass-balance modeling predicts travel-borne viral importation at airports
papers.abstract: Aircraft wastewater surveillance (AWS) has emerged as a non-invasive tool for travel-mediated pathogen detection, yet its utility remains largely descriptive without capacity to translate environmental concentrations into quantitative infection dynamics. This study aimed to advance AWS from passive pathogen detection to an active predictive framework by integrating mass balance back-calculation with hybrid-capture genomic surveillance. To resolve a critical parameter gap in mass-balance modeling-namely, the fecal shedding kinetics of asymptomatic influenza carriers, we prospectively enrolled 238 non-respiratory outpatients at Nanchang People's Hospital and quantified fecal influenza A/B virus loads (IAV /IBV) by RT-qPCR. Asymptomatic IAV and IBV shedding was detected across all age strata, with median viral loads of 5.9 and 5.0 log10 copies/g, respectively, and positivity rates ranging from 41.2% (adolescents) to 62.1% (children <10 years), thereby establishing the first empirical fecal shedding parameter set for carriage-inclusive mass-balance back-calculation. Between January and July 2025, we prospectively collected 240 aircraft wastewater samples from six Asia-Pacific flight routes and 60 longitudinal sewage samples from an international airport in Nanjing, China. RT-qPCR was conducted to quantify norovirus, influenza virus, mpox, and dengue virus. A mass balance back-calculation model was established to convert wastewater viral concentrations into estimated weekly numbers of infected inbound passengers. Viral genomes were enriched via hybrid-capture panels and subjected to high-resolution phylogenetic analysis. The predictive framework estimated weekly flight-imported infection cases for norovirus GII, influenza A virus and dengue virus, revealing distinct regional importation curves synchronized with epidemiological trends in countries of origin (95% concordance). Phylogenetic analysis resolved multiple independent viral introductions. Further employing a Susceptible-Exposed-Infectious-Recovered model, we forecasted 14-day community infection burden and validated predictions against clinical surveillance data, demonstrating significant concordance with IAV (r=0.71) and norovirus clinical visits (r=0.84). By bridging quantitative infection dynamics with lineage-resolution genomics, this study establishes a paradigm shift from qualitative pathogen detection to predictive outbreak intelligence.

analysis.summary_en: This study addresses the need to move aircraft wastewater surveillance (AWS) from passive pathogen detection to an active predictive framework. It focuses on seasonal influenza viruses, specifically influenza A and B, by integrating mass balance back-calculation with hybrid-capture genomic surveillance. The research enrolled 238 non-respiratory outpatients to quantify fecal viral loads, revealing asymptomatic shedding across all age groups with median viral loads of 5.9 and 5.0 log10 copies/g for influenza A and B, respectively. The findings establish the first empirical fecal shedding parameter set for mass-balance modeling. The study also collected wastewater samples from six Asia-Pacific flight routes and validated predictions against clinical surveillance data, showing significant concordance with influenza A virus and norovirus. The results demonstrate the potential of AWS to predict travel-borne viral importation and provide insights into outbreak intelligence. However, the study's predictive framework is limited to the context of the collected data and does not extend to other viruses without explicit target-specific evidence.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 航空废水(AWS)已成为一种非侵入性的旅行媒介病原体检测工具,但其应用仍主要停留在描述性层面,无法将环境浓度转化为定量感染动态。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究旨在通过将质能平衡逆向计算与混合捕获技术相结合,将AWS从被动病原体检测推进到主动预测框架。
elements_zh.methods: 为解决质能平衡建模中的关键参数缺口——即无症状流感携带者的粪便排毒动力学,我们前瞻性地招募了238名非呼吸道门诊患者,并通过RT-qPCR定量检测了粪便中甲型/乙型流感病毒载量(IAV/IBV)。
elements_zh.main_results: 无症状IAV和IBV排毒在所有年龄层中均被检测到,其中中位病毒载量分别为5.9和5.0 log10 copies/g,阳性率从41.2%(青少年)到62.1%(<10岁儿童)不等,从而建立了首个包含携带者在内的质能平衡逆向计算的实证粪便排毒参数集。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该预测框架估计了诺如病毒GII、流感A病毒和登革病毒的每周航班输入感染病例,揭示了与原发国流行趋势同步的区域输入曲线(95%一致性)。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 通过将定量感染动态与谱系分辨率基因组学相结合,本研究确立了从定性病原体检测向预测性病毒情报转变的新范式。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 进一步采用易感-暴露-感染-恢复(SEIR)模型,我们预测了14天内的社区感染负担,并将预测结果与临床数据进行验证,显示出与IAV(r=0.71)和诺如病毒临床就诊(r=0.84)显著的一致性。

papers.source_body_en: Aircraft wastewater surveillance (AWS) has emerged as a non-invasive tool for travel-mediated pathogen detection, yet its utility remains largely descriptive without capacity to translate environmental concentrations into quantitative infection dynamics. This study aimed to advance AWS from passive pathogen detection to an active predictive framework by integrating mass balance back-calculation with hybrid-capture genomic surveillance. To resolve a critical parameter gap in mass-balance modeling-namely, the fecal shedding kinetics of asymptomatic influenza carriers, we prospectively enrolled 238 non-respiratory outpatients at Nanchang People's Hospital and quantified fecal influenza A/B virus loads (IAV /IBV) by RT-qPCR. Asymptomatic IAV and IBV shedding was detected across all age strata, with median viral loads of 5.9 and 5.0 log10 copies/g, respectively, and positivity rates ranging from 41.2% (adolescents) to 62.1% (children <10 years), thereby establishing the first empirical fecal shedding parameter set for carriage-inclusive mass-balance back-calculation. Between January and July 2025, we prospectively collected 240 aircraft wastewater samples from six Asia-Pacific flight routes and 60 longitudinal sewage samples from an international airport in Nanjing, China. RT-qPCR was conducted to quantify norovirus, influenza virus, mpox, and dengue virus. A mass balance back-calculation model was established to convert wastewater viral concentrations into estimated weekly numbers of infected inbound passengers. Viral genomes were enriched via hybrid-capture panels and subjected to high-resolution phylogenetic analysis. The predictive framework estimated weekly flight-imported infection cases for norovirus GII, influenza A virus and dengue virus, revealing distinct regional importation curves synchronized with epidemiological trends in countries of origin (95% concordance). Phylogenetic analysis resolved multiple independent viral introductions. Further employing a Susceptible-Exposed-Infectious-Recovered model, we forecasted 14-day community infection burden and validated predictions against clinical surveillance data, demonstrating significant concordance with IAV (r=0.71) and norovirus clinical visits (r=0.84). By bridging quantitative infection dynamics with lineage-resolution genomics, this study establishes a paradigm shift from qualitative pathogen detection to predictive outbreak intelligence.
papers.abstract_zh: 航空废水(AWS)已成为一种非侵入性的旅行媒介病原体检测工具,但其应用仍主要停留在描述性层面,无法将环境浓度转化为定量感染动态。本研究旨在通过将质能平衡逆向计算与混合捕获技术相结合,将AWS从被动病原体检测推进到主动预测框架。为解决质能平衡建模中的关键参数缺口——即无症状流感携带者的粪便排毒动力学,我们前瞻性地招募了238名非呼吸道门诊患者,并通过RT-qPCR定量检测了粪便中甲型/乙型流感病毒载量(IAV/IBV)。无症状IAV和IBV排毒在所有年龄层中均被检测到,其中中位病毒载量分别为5.9和5.0 log10 copies/g,阳性率从41.2%(青少年)到62.1%(<10岁儿童)不等,从而建立了首个包含携带者在内的质能平衡逆向计算的实证粪便排毒参数集。2025年1月至7月期间,我们前瞻性地从六个亚太航线收集了240份航空废水样本,并从中国南京的国际机场收集了60份纵向污水样本。通过RT-qPCR对诺如病毒、流感病毒、猴痘病毒和登革病毒进行了定量检测。建立了一个质能平衡逆向计算模型,将废水中的病毒浓度转化为估计的每周入境感染乘客数量。病毒通过混合捕获面板进行富集,并进行高分辨率系统发育分析。该预测框架估计了诺如病毒GII、流感A病毒和登革病毒的每周航班输入感染病例,揭示了与原发国流行趋势同步的区域输入曲线(95%一致性)。系统发育分析明确了多个独立的病毒输入事件。进一步采用易感-暴露-感染-恢复(SEIR)模型,我们预测了14天内的社区感染负担,并将预测结果与临床数据进行验证,显示出与IAV(r=0.71)和诺如病毒临床就诊(r=0.84)显著的一致性。通过将定量感染动态与谱系分辨率基因组学相结合,本研究确立了从定性病原体检测向预测性病毒情报转变的新范式。
